_help: Single source of truth for Prism's voice commands.
The HUD's Commands tab and the Vercel console both display this file.
'patterns' are case-insensitive regular expressions Prism matches against what you say, checked in the order listed here.
Commands without patterns are built in (handled in prism.py) and listed here so they show on the cheat sheet.
'say' are example phrasings; the first one is what the HUD sends when you click the command.

commands.title: Run all store tasks
commands.does: Missed sales PDF for the last 7 days, opens Cost Fixer with the missing-cost count, and opens Liquidation with StockX and eBay.

commands.title: Today's task list
say: What do I need to do today?
commands.does: Reads your three tasks with live numbers: missed sales this week, items missing cost, and the liquidation check. Opens nothing.

commands.title: Missed sales report (7 days)
commands.does: Pulls the last 7 days from Missed Sales, builds a PDF report and opens it on screen, then reads you the headline numbers.

commands.title: Missed sales this week
say: How many missed sales this week?
commands.does: Says the 7-day count and the most-requested item. No files, no windows.

commands.title: Items missing cost
commands.does: Checks ConsignR through Cost Fixer and says how many store-owned items have no cost. Opens nothing.

commands.title: Open Cost Fixer
commands.does: Opens Cost Fixer and tells you how many items still need a cost.
patterns: \b(open|pull up|bring up|launch|show|start)( me)?( up)?( the| my)? cost ?fixer\b

commands.title: Liquidation check
commands.does: Opens the HOH Liquidation artifact, StockX Pro sales history (Completed) and eBay Seller Hub orders, so you can add anything that sold.
patterns: \b(open|pull up|bring up|launch|show|start)( me)?( up)?( the| my)? liquidation\b

commands.title: Open any app
commands.does: Opens any app in your registry: Vercel projects and Claude artifacts. Say 'open', 'pull up', 'bring up' or 'show me' plus its name. The full list is in the Apps section below.

commands.title: What can you open?
commands.does: Reads out your Vercel projects and a few of your Claude artifacts.

commands.title: Restart / update Prism
commands.does: Restarts Prism, pulling the latest version from GitHub first. The HUD reconnects by itself.

commands.title: Wake Prism
commands.does: Wakes Prism. First wake of the session (or after an hour) includes the weather.

commands.title: Weather
commands.does: Current conditions, today's high and low, and rain chance.

commands.title: Mute the mic
commands.does: Switches the microphone off. Turn it back on from the HUD (Mic button or press M).

commands.title: Stand by
commands.does: Ends the conversation. Prism goes back to waiting for two claps.

commands.title: Ask Claude
say: What's the latest on the Cowboys?
What time does Midland Park Mall close today?
Draft a reply to a customer asking about Black Cats
commands.does: Anything else goes to Claude (your Claude Code login), which can search the web. You get a short spoken answer.
